name: Chamber of Commerce Committee Liaison Meeting Agenda
minutes_text:
CITY OF BEVERLY HILLS
  455 North Rexford Drive
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210
  Video Teleconference
  Beverly Hills City Council Liaison / Chamber of Commerce Committee Meeting

  SPECIAL MEETING HIGHLIGHTS

  Wednesday, January 31, 2024
  4:00 PM

MEETING CALLED TO ORDER
Date / Time:  January 31, 2024 / 4:00 PM
IN ATTENDANCE:  Mayor Julian Gold, Councilmember Lili Bosse, Deputy City Manager Keith
  Sterling, Community Outreach Manager Magdalena Davis, Chamber of
  Commerce President and CEO Todd Johnson, Chamber of Commerce
  Director for Economic Development and Governmental Affairs Brittany
  Ganson

  1) Public Comment:

  None

  2) Beverly Hills Chamber of Commerce Update on Fiscal Year 2023-2024 Quarter Two
  Programs and Initiatives:
  a. Presentation by Brittany Ganson.
  i. The Chamber conducted a number of marketing and outreach support
  campaigns for a number of city and partner events during Q2 such as Office
  Hours with Doctor Gold, 60 Second Shoutouts, Dine LA Restaurant Week.
  ii. The Chamber conducted 7 of their 26 Walk the Neighborhood events
  during the same time period. These walks covered topics ranging from LA
  Metro Station Naming outreach, Rodeo Drive Holiday Lighting and Holiday
  Programming, to Small Business Task Force outreach.
  iii. The New York Business trip met with 22 businesses, of which 15 were new
  businesses and 9 retentions. Of the 22 businesses, 11 were retail, 11 were
  restaurants, and 2 were experiential.
  iv. As a result of these meetings, 8 new businesses expressed sincere interest
  in expanding to Beverly Hills such as Koch, H & H Bagels, Gabriel Kreuther,
  San Ambrose, and others.
  v. Baccarat has expressed a high level of interest in expanding to Beverly
  Hills and is actively looking for sites close to Rodeo to expand to.
  vi. Other economic development and business support events that occurred
  were meeting of the Property Owner’s Task Force, the Small Business
  Development Center, the Broker’s Roundtables, the Small Business Task
  Force, Mayor business retention Meetings, and LA Metro Subway
  Stakeholder meetings.
 Highlights for January 31, 2024
Chamber of Commerce Committee

  vii. The Beverly Hills Chamber retains a strong presence on social media,
  dominating Instagram follower numbers when compared to the West
  Hollywood, Santa Monica, Century City, and Los Angeles chambers.
  However, our Facebook followers have declined over the 4-month period,
  falling behind Los Angeles.
  viii. The Hidden Gems campaign was expanded into Q2 and while it had a
  sizeable reach, this reach did not convert into visits or likes & follows.
  ix. The Love Health Happiness campaign generated less responses than
  other campaigns throughout the year. The key learning from this campaign
  was that campaigns that feature actual businesses perform better than
  more abstract campaigns.
  x. Workplan items in development.
  1. Regional Business Attraction deck.
  2. Economic Development Webpages.
  3. New Business Newsletter.
  4. Maimi Feasibility Study: meetings were held in October and a report
  is in development.
  xi. Todd Johnson has conducted a number of interviews with regional media.
  These interviews show that the media has moved away from the safety
  issue and are now focusing on the economic outlook of the city such as
  vacancies and major projects.
  xii. The chamber held four ribbon cuttings, two of which required special event
  fee waivers, which the chamber thanks the council for granting.
  b. Ralph Lauren has conducted two successful coffee pop ups but they are still
  deciding on whether or not they want to do it full time.

  3) Future Agenda Items:

  None

  4) Adjournment:
  Date / Time: January 31, 2024 / 4:26 PM
